source_title: Offering Unmatched Performance, Leadership Energy Efficiency and Next-Generation Architecture, AMD Brings 4th Gen AMD EPYC Processors to The Modern Data Center

claim_relevant_segments.general_availability: announced the general availability of the 4th Gen AMD EPYC™ processors
claim_relevant_segments.ddr5_support: introduces support for DDR5 memory and PCIe® Gen 5

claim_relevant_visible_text:
announced the general availability of the 4th Gen AMD EPYC™ processors
introduces support for DDR5 memory and PCIe® Gen 5
researcher_paraphrase: AMD announced 4th Gen EPYC general availability on November 10, 2022 and stated that the platform introduced DDR5 memory support.
precision_guard: This establishes dated server-platform enablement and DDR5 support. It does not establish memory-module qualification, deployment volume, DIMM content per server or DRAM bit-demand onset.
authority_boundary: AMD's dated launch release is primary for the platform's general availability and announced DDR5 support.
